The '''1922 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 36th staging of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]]'s premier [[inter county|inter-county]] [[hurling]] tournament. The championship began in May 1922 and ended on 9 September 1923.

The championship was won by [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] who secured the title following a 4–2 to 2–6 defeat of [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] in the All-Ireland final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |title=All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Roll of Honour |publisher=The GAA website |access-date=27 July 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905085701/http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |archive-date=5 September 2011 }}</ref> This was their 8th All-Ireland title, their first in nine championship seasons.

[[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] were the [[1921 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]] but were defeated by Tipperary in the Munster final
